description: This file implements a React component for a role comparison page in a skill/competency management application. It enables users to select roles, view competency overlaps and gaps, and receive learning recommendations. It fetches data from a Supabase backend and performs gap analysis with fallback local logic.

methods.name: difficultyScore
methods.description: Maps textual difficulty levels to numeric scores for ranking learning items.

methods.name: fmtLevel
methods.description: Formats a numeric proficiency level for display.

methods.name: competencyNameForId
methods.description: Retrieves the competency name given its ID from the list of role competencies.

methods.name: StatusPill
methods.description: React component displaying a color-coded status label based on gap severity.
